description: Figure 10 illustrates the model’s evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and Feed Forward Network (FFN) components at varying ratios. The x-axis is labeled “Sparsity Settings” and has a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, with tick labels at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%. The y-axis is labeled “Perplexity” and has a linear scale ranging from 11 to 15, with tick labels at 11, 12, 13, 14, and 15. There are four lines displayed on the plot. The first line is solid, blue, and represents “MoH-100%ATTN-100%FFN”, starting at approximately 11.61 at 0% sparsity and ending at approximately 14.31 at 100% sparsity. The second line is dashed, orange, and represents “MoH-50%ATTN-50%FFN”, starting at approximately 12.24 at 0% sparsity and ending at approximately 13.57 at 100% sparsity. The third line is solid, green, and represents “MoH-25%ATTN-25%FFN”, starting at approximately 12.89 at 0% sparsity and ending at approximately 14.13 at 100% sparsity. The fourth line is dashed, purple, and represents “MoH-0%ATTN-0%FFN”, starting at approximately 13.43 at 0% sparsity and ending at approximately 14.78 at 100% sparsity.
